scope: Post-training credit diagnostic on all six full-permission, eight-writer, fresh/all continuous-state checkpoints. Do not tune on this diagnostic.
design: In each of 64 contacts experience a private two-odor relation, fresh every four contacts, random left/right orientation, 10% taste slips. Record both complementary preferences. Each life carries neural activity, weights, bias, and support. Actual motors greedy, edit addresses and operations drawn from the native policy with shared sampling keys; no optimization.
intervention: On the full trajectory let one sampled command execute. On the paired clone omit only that command. Both clones carry identical post-inspection activity, then live through the same exogenous world and same random draws for eight future contacts. Both continue to write. A difference can propagate through choice-dependent taste and subsequent writing. Record any changed action, signed net true correct choices and the largest motor-logit difference. Separate all commands, changed parameters only, and incident-writer commands. These are observer-only counterfactuals, not feedback to the living graph.
interpretation: Zero changed discrete choices within eight contacts does not imply a mathematically zero effect, nor does it determine the edit's ultimate lifetime value.
